name: io.github.mutual-solutions/zap-mcp
title: Zap! KiCad autorouter
description: KiCad PCB autorouter: route a placed board, get a JSON report (DRC, shorts, JLCPCB, copper heat)

environmentVariables.name: ZAP_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the Zap! API key (sign in at https://zap.mutual.solutions/auth/login). Optional: without a key, try_route_board routes small boards.

environmentVariables.name: ZAP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Zap! API key itself, instead of ZAP_API_KEY_FILE.
